practices_evaluation.justification: Test exercises public API (Grafo constructor and public methods) and does not use reflection or inspect internals; therefore focuses on observable behavior.
Uses specific assertions (assertEquals, assertTrue, assertNotSame) and includes descriptive failure messages for each assertion.
Contains concise Given/When/Then comments and a brief explanatory comment about self-loop; no commented-out code or excessive commentary.
No use of Random, current time, Thread.sleep, or external dependencies; test behavior is deterministic based on inputs.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: Test only uses local in-memory objects and does not create files, databases, or modify static/global state; no cleanup required.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: Class-level @Category(UnitTest.class) is present and meaningful; tests are categorized for selective execution.
